data.title: Sr. Software Development Engineer
data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

 

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.




THE ROLE: 

AMD is looking for a specialized software engineer who is passionate about improving the performance of key applications and benchmarks. You will be a member of a core team of incredibly talented industry specialists and will work with the very latest hardware and software technology.  

 

THE PERSON: 

The ideal candidate should be passionate about software engineering and possess leadership skills to drive sophisticated issues to resolution. Able to communicate effectively and work optimally with different teams across AMD.  

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 

  • Work with AMD’s architecture specialists to improve future products  
  • Apply a data minded approach to target optimization efforts 
  • Stay informed of software and hardware trends and innovations, especially pertaining to algorithms and architecture 
  • Design and develop new groundbreaking AMD technologies 
  • Participating in new ASIC and hardware bring ups  
  • Debugging/fix existing issues and research alternative, more efficient ways to accomplish the same work 
  • Develop technical relationships with peers and partners 

 

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE: 

  • Strong object-oriented programming background, C/C++ preferred 
  • Ability to write high quality code with a keen attention to detail 
  • Experience with modern concurrent programming and threading APIs 
  • Experience with Windows, Linux and/or Android operating system development  
  • Experience with software development processes and tools such as debuggers, source code control systems (GitHub) and profilers is a plus 
  • Effective communication and problem-solving skills 

 

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS: 

  • Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent 

 

#LI-JW2

data.title: Returns Debug Engineer
data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

 

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.




THE ROLE:

Returns Debug and RMA execution in Quality & Reliability organization, provide supportive functions to the organization to ensure customer quality issue being addressed evoking the required actions via failure analysis to improve product quality.

 

THE PERSON:

You will also need to possess strong verbal and written communication skills which are essential when working with a global team. A proactive, outstanding teammate who focuses on teamwork, team building, and growing team success.

AMD's environment is fast paced, results oriented and built upon a legion of forward-thinking people with a passion for winning technology!

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Perform analysis & report writing on customer returns electrical FA, include duplicate customer reported failure on Platform level and perform board level debug, analysis on Automated Test Equipment (ATE) and System Level Test (SLT).
  • Customer returns debug covering pre & post Mass Production, field return including Excursion/Critical issue, also cover debug for Defect Part Per Million (DPPM) improvement.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration by proactively engaging with Device Analysis and Product Engineering teams to lead fault isolation and root-cause investigations.
  • Identify and define test coverage enhancements that strengthen product quality, prevent customer-facing failures, and support long-term reliability improvements.
  • Provide technical direction in diagnosing complex issues, influencing validation strategies, and ensuring findings translate into actionable quality improvements across functions.
  • Provide conclusive and convincing results and align with Program/PLQ/Customer Interfacing team on final analysis report writing for customer communication.
  • Local product ownership roles that include but not limited to understanding, tracking and releases of ATE/SLT/OSV which covers RMA/OSV program, test program contents, and Go-To person on owned product technical queries.
  • Role model as a coach for internal team that able to guide junior on technical challenges that arise during work for specific IP or failure category.
  • Other duties as assigned by supervisor.

 

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Engineering background, capable of understanding common electrical terms and schematics on PC systems or Server platform or Graphic card
  • Be capable of using different instruments for HW test and debug, like oscilloscope, multimeter.
  • x86 architecture knowledge is much preferred
  • Window and Linux proficiency.
  • Java, Python, Perl coding or Linux Shell scripting skills
  • Experience working in root causes digital or analog failure or SCAN/MBIST/High Speed Loopback failure is a plus.
  • Candidate should be analytical and detail oriented, strongly interested in debugging complex system, self-starter, and fast learner
  • JTAG knowledge is a plus.
  • Knowledge in ATE test class/method experience with Advantest 93k platform is a plus.
  • Experience in AI or Machine Learning project or task is a plus. 

 

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering or Computer Engineering with preferred > 5 relevant years of experience

 

LOCATION:

Suzhou, China

data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them.

 

AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.




THE ROLE:

As a Silicon Design Engineer, you will work with formal experts and designers to verify formal properties and drive convergence. 

  

THE PERSON:

You have a passion for modern, complex processor architecture, digital design, and verification in general. You are a team player who has excellent communication skills. You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills and are willing to learn and ready to take on problems. 

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Drive formal verification for the block and write formal properties and assertions to verify the design 
  • Coordinate with RTL engineers to implement logic design for better clock gating and verify the various aspects of the design 
  • Write tests, sequences, and testbench components in SystemVerilog and UVM along with formal to achieve verification of the design 
  • Responsible for verification quality metrics like pass rates, code coverage and functional coverage 

 

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Project level experience with design concepts and RTL implementation for same 
  • Experience or familiarity with formal tools and/or functional verification tools by VCS, Cadence, Mentor Graphics 
  • Good understanding of computer organization/architecture 

 

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • Masters degree in computer engineering/Electrical Engineering

data.title: AI Software Development Engineer
data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

 

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.




THE ROLE:

AI applications no longer run on a single model. They combine frontier and open models, large and small, with agents and tools. Every request needs a decision: which model should answer, at what cost, and under which safety and privacy policies. We build the layer that makes that decision.

 

 

AMD is looking for a software engineer to join the core team behind vllm-sr. The team owns the whole stack: the router, the serving engine, the decision models and the open-source community. You will train and serve on AMD Instinct GPUs, help make ROCm a first-class platform for intelligent routing, and ship your work upstream as code, open models and papers that reach users around the world.

 

THE PERSON:

You are a hands-on engineer who wants to build software that people rely on. You have strong fundamentals in systems, machine learning, or both, and you understand how large language models are trained and served. AI is part of how you work every day, and you have taken products from idea to production with it. You measure before you optimize, and you write code that others are glad to review and maintain.

 

You are comfortable working in the open, where designs, code reviews and discussions happen on GitHub with a global community of contributors. The work spans systems, models and community, and we don't expect anyone to bring all of it on day one. We look for real depth in one area, such as routing and serving systems, inference performance or model training, and the curiosity to grow into the rest.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Build the routing intelligence of vllm-sr, from decision models that pick the right model for every request to semantic, policy-based and workload-aware routing, semantic caching, and routing for safety, privacy, tools and agents.
  • Make vllm-sr simple to deploy and operate in production, with first-class integrations for vLLM, Kubernetes, Envoy, Gateway API and AI gateways.
  • Build vllm-sr into a universal serving engine for decision models that exposes the System One API and runs efficiently on everything from AMD Instinct GPUs to CPUs.
  • Optimize decision model inference across batching, memory, latency and throughput, down to GPU kernels in HIP or Triton on ROCm where it matters.
  • Train our foundation decision models across sizes and keep pushing their capabilities to the frontier, owning data, training, post-training and evaluation.
  • Build an auto research pipeline that keeps iterating on our decision models, automating experiments from data generation to training, evaluation and analysis.
  • Co-design the decision models with the serving engine, so that every new capability ships with the performance to serve it.
  • Make decisions with data: build benchmarks and evaluations, profile end-to-end systems, and measure routing quality, latency and cost.
  • Ship production-quality software with strong testing, CI, observability and reliability.
  • Work upstream first: review and land community contributions, triage issues, ship releases and help the community grow.
  • Represent AMD and vllm-sr at conferences and workshops, and share the work through talks, demos, blogs and documentation that grow the community and show what vllm-sr can do on AMD GPUs.
  • Partner across AMD: with ROCm, kernel and AI framework teams to remove bottlenecks and validate vllm-sr on new AMD GPU platforms, and with Enterprise and IT teams to support AMD's internal products and IT services with vllm-sr.

 

Requirements:

  • Fresh Graduates with strong programming skills in Python and at least one of Go, Rust or C++.
  • Hands-on experience with large language models: serving them (vLLM, SGLang or similar), training them, or building products on them.
  • AI-native engineering: deep, daily use of AI coding agents and agentic workflows to design, build, test and ship, with the judgment to verify and correct their output.
  • Proven end-to-end delivery: products you built and shipped with AI driving the work, from idea and design through deployment and operations.
  • Solid fundamentals in systems, machine learning, or both.
  • Comfortable working in the open: GitHub workflows, public code review and clear written English.
  • Contributions to open-source projects such as vllm-sr, vLLM, SGLang, PyTorch, Hugging Face, Envoy or Kubernetes.
  • GPU programming experience (HIP, CUDA, Triton), or ROCm on AMD Instinct GPUs.
  • Experience with model routing, API gateways or LLM inference optimization.
  • Experience training or post-training models such as classifiers, reward models or multimodal models.
  • Papers at top machine learning or systems conferences.
    Technical writing, public speaking or community building.

 

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
    Research experience in machine learning systems, distributed systems or high-performance computing is a plus.

 

LOCATION:
Seoul, Korea

We look for real depth in one area, such as routing and serving systems, inference performance or model training, and the curiosity to grow into the rest.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Build the routing intelligence of vllm-sr, from decision models that pick the right model for every request to semantic, policy-based and workload-aware routing, semantic caching, and routing for safety, privacy, tools and agents.
  • Make vllm-sr simple to deploy and operate in production, with first-class integrations for vLLM, Kubernetes, Envoy, Gateway API and AI gateways.
  • Build vllm-sr into a universal serving engine for decision models that exposes the System One API and runs efficiently on everything from AMD Instinct GPUs to CPUs.
  • Optimize decision model inference across batching, memory, latency and throughput, down to GPU kernels in HIP or Triton on ROCm where it matters.
  • Train our foundation decision models across sizes and keep pushing their capabilities to the frontier, owning data, training, post-training and evaluation.
  • Build an auto research pipeline that keeps iterating on our decision models, automating experiments from data generation to training, evaluation and analysis.
  • Co-design the decision models with the serving engine, so that every new capability ships with the performance to serve it.
  • Make decisions with data: build benchmarks and evaluations, profile end-to-end systems, and measure routing quality, latency and cost.
  • Ship production-quality software with strong testing, CI, observability and reliability.
  • Work upstream first: review and land community contributions, triage issues, ship releases and help the community grow.
  • Represent AMD and vllm-sr at conferences and workshops, and share the work through talks, demos, blogs and documentation that grow the community and show what vllm-sr can do on AMD GPUs.
  • Partner across AMD: with ROCm, kernel and AI framework teams to remove bottlenecks and validate vllm-sr on new AMD GPU platforms, and with Enterprise and IT teams to support AMD's internal products and IT services with vllm-sr.

 

Requirements:

  • Fresh Graduates with strong programming skills in Python and at least one of Go, Rust or C++.
  • Hands-on experience with large language models: serving them (vLLM, SGLang or similar), training them, or building products on them.
  • AI-native engineering: deep, daily use of AI coding agents and agentic workflows to design, build, test and ship, with the judgment to verify and correct their output.
  • Proven end-to-end delivery: products you built and shipped with AI driving the work, from idea and design through deployment and operations.
  • Solid fundamentals in systems, machine learning, or both.
  • Comfortable working in the open: GitHub workflows, public code review and clear written English.
  • Contributions to open-source projects such as vllm-sr, vLLM, SGLang, PyTorch, Hugging Face, Envoy or Kubernetes.
  • GPU programming experience (HIP, CUDA, Triton), or ROCm on AMD Instinct GPUs.
  • Experience with model routing, API gateways or LLM inference optimization.
  • Experience training or post-training models such as classifiers, reward models or multimodal models.
  • Papers at top machine learning or systems conferences.
    Technical writing, public speaking or community building.

 

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
    Research experience in machine learning systems, distributed systems or high-performance computing is a plus.

 

LOCATION:
Seoul, Korea

data.title: Packaging Engineer
data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

 

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.




THE ROLE:

Technology leader responsible for driving Co-Packaged Optics (CPO) and Silicon Photonics technology development from concept to high-volume manufacturing. The successful candidate will collaborate with product architects, Silicon Photonics technology teams, foundry partners, and OSATs to define future optical interconnect solutions, packaging architectures, and technology roadmaps.

This role requires deep expertise in Silicon Photonics technology and manufacturing, spanning wafer process development, device integration, optical packaging, assembly, and qualification. The candidate will lead development initiatives from concept through production, defining process requirements, DFM/DFY strategies, and yield improvement roadmaps.

The successful candidate will drive cross-functional engineering teams across multiple geographies to develop next-generation optical engine solutions, establish package architectures, and enable scalable manufacturing processes. The role also involves executive-level communication, ecosystem engagement, and technical leadership to resolve yield, reliability, process integration, and manufacturing challenges across the Silicon Photonics value chain.

 

THE PERSON:

Should possess a proven track record of delivering innovative photonics and packaging solution from concept to production. He/she should have extensive experience in Silicon Photonics technology development, including wafer fabrication, process integration, device manufacturing, yield improvement, and product qualification. The candidate should demonstrate strong leadership in driving technology roadmap definition, architecture development, process innovation, and manufacturing readiness across internal and external organizations.

Success in this role requires the ability to influence technical direction, lead global cross-functional teams, and effectively communicate complex technical issues and recommendations to executive management, product architects, technology partners, foundries, OSATs, and suppliers.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Work with product architects and Silicon Photonics technology teams to define optical engine architectures, package architectures, and long-term technology roadmaps.
  • Drive Silicon Photonics technology development from wafer process integration through packaging, qualification, and production deployment.
  • Partner with foundries to develop and optimize Silicon Photonics manufacturing processes, yield strategies, and technology qualification plans.
  • Design multi-fiber optical connectors and work with ecosystem partners to establish scalable optical connectivity solutions.
  • Enable new package technology development initiatives including 2.5D, 3D, hybrid bonding, and optical packaging technologies from concept to full qualification.
  • Drive test vehicle design, wafer and package characterization, and manufacturing experiments to establish design rules and DFM/DFY guidelines.
  • Establish yield improvement roadmaps and drive implementation of data analytics methodologies across wafer fabrication, assembly, and test operations.
  • Lead technical problem-solving activities related to process integration, yield, reliability, and manufacturing scalability.
  • Build strategic relationships with foundries, OSATs, suppliers, and ecosystem partners to enable production deployment and technology leadership.

 

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Proven experience developing and deploying Silicon Photonics technologies and products from concept through qualification and high-volume manufacturing.
  • Strong understanding of Silicon Photonics wafer fabrication, process integration, device manufacturing, yield improvement, process control, and foundry operations.
  • Experience working directly with Silicon Photonics foundries on technology development, process qualification, yield enhancement, and manufacturing ramp.
  • Demonstrated expertise in optical engine development, photonics couplers, fiber attach, optical assembly, and associated DFM, test, and reliability methodologies.
  • Deep knowledge of advanced packaging technologies including 2.5D/3D integration, CoWoS, fan-out packaging, hybrid bonding, and heterogeneous integration.
  • Proven track record of leading semiconductor technology development and qualification programs for high-performance computing, networking, or data center products.
  • Strong experience managing external manufacturing partners and ecosystem stakeholders, including foundries, OSATs, suppliers, and technology partners.
  • Demonstrated leadership driving global cross-functional teams and influencing technical strategy across product, technology development, and manufacturing organizations.
  • Experience with statistical process control (SPC), yield analytics, reliability engineering, failure analysis, and data-driven manufacturing optimization.

 

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

BS/MS/PhD in Material Science, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science,  Applied Mathematics, Electrical Engineering,  or equivalent

 

LOCATION:

Hsinchu, Taiwan

data.title: Life Sciences AI Research Engineer
data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

 

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.




THE ROLE

AMD is looking for a hands-on research engineer to advance life sciences computing at the intersection of computational biology, AI, and high-performance computing.

 

You will investigate emerging scientific workloads, develop and optimize algorithms, and build software that enables researchers to tackle larger and more complex biological problems on AMD platforms. Areas of interest include genomics, biological foundation models, protein and molecular modeling, and computational drug discovery.

 

Working with AMD researchers, software engineers, and external collaborators, you will take projects from scientific problem definition through implementation and evaluation. Your findings will help identify where AMD can deliver meaningful advances in life sciences computing and guide future research and software investments.

 

THE PERSON

You bring deep understanding of a computational life sciences domain and the programming skills to turn scientific ideas into working software. You enjoy writing code, testing hypotheses, and solving difficult technical problems. You can distinguish improvements that matter to a scientific workflow from gains in an isolated benchmark and communicate your findings clearly to both domain scientists and systems engineers.

 

We value depth in one or more relevant areas, curiosity across disciplines, and the ability to take ownership of a technical project from investigation to validated results.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Investigate important and emerging life sciences workloads, understanding their scientific objectives, algorithms, computational requirements, and practical limitations.
  • Develop, implement, and evaluate algorithms and AI methods for applications in genomics, biomolecular modeling, or related areas.
  • Profile and optimize scientific applications and AI workflows on AMD platforms, addressing bottlenecks in computation, memory, data processing, and communication.
  • Explore algorithmic reformulations, parallelization strategies, numerical precision, and GPU acceleration while preserving scientific validity.
  • Build reproducible benchmarks that measure end-to-end performance, scalability, resource use, and relevant scientific outcomes.
  • Work directly with academic and industry collaborators to translate scientific needs into technical requirements and working implementations.
  • Contribute reusable software, optimized operators, and improvements to relevant open-source projects.
  • Translate experimental findings into recommendations for AMD’s research priorities, software capabilities, and hardware requirements.
  • Communicate results through technical reports, demonstrations, publications, and invention disclosures, as appropriate.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

  • Strong computational expertise in at least one life sciences area, such as computational genomics, bioinformatics, protein modeling, computational chemistry, or molecular simulation.
  • Hands-on experience implementing scientific algorithms or developing machine learning models for biological applications.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and experience with C++ or another language used for high-performance scientific computing.
  • Solid understanding of algorithms, data structures, numerical methods, and experimental evaluation.
  • Experience profiling, debugging, and improving computational software.
  • Ability to work independently on a defined technical problem and collaborate effectively across scientific and engineering disciplines.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

  • Biological foundation models, protein structure prediction or design, molecular generative models, or genomic sequence modeling.
  • Scientific AI architectures, including transformers, geometric deep learning, graph neural networks, or diffusion models.
  • GPU programming and optimization using HIP, CUDA, Triton, or comparable technologies.
  • Deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, including custom operators or distributed training and inference.
  • Parallel algorithms, multi-GPU computing, or large-scale scientific workflows.
  • Established life sciences software ecosystems and experience extending or contributing to open-source tools.
  • Research contributions demonstrated through publications, software, patents, or deployed scientific applications.

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS

Master’s, or PhD in Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Computational Chemistry, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience preferred.

 

LOCATION: Longmont, CO; Austin, TX and Santa Clara, Ca are options. 

 

This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

data.title: Medical Imaging and AI Research Engineer
data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

 

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.




THE ROLE

 

AMD is looking for a research engineer with practical implementation experience to advance AI-based medical imaging at the intersection of clinical imaging, deep learning, and high-performance computing on AMD platforms.

 

You will work across the full medical imaging workflow, from data preparation and preprocessing through model inference, post-processing, and evaluation, investigating modern pipelines and optimizing their design and implementation on AMD platforms. You will build reference designs, GPU kernels, and agentic frameworks that let these pipelines run at maximum performance on AMD devices such as the Ryzen AI Max+ and Radeon AI Pro, with hardware–model co-design as a central theme: tailoring model architecture to the properties of the underlying hardware so that computation maps efficiently onto the device. Areas of interest include image reconstruction, segmentation, detection, classification, tracking, and quality assessment across modalities such as ultrasound, CT, MRI, and X-ray.

 

Working with AMD engineering and research teams, industry partners, and clinical collaborators, you will take imaging pipelines from problem definition through implementation, optimization, and evaluation; document your methods and results; and feed what you learn back to the libraries and kernel teams. Your findings will help establish the design frameworks and best practices for customers migrating imaging pipelines to AMD devices, and over time steer the team’s roadmap toward the co-design of next-generation imaging models: architected from the outset around AMD hardware for better mapping and efficiency.

 

THE PERSON

You bring a strong understanding of AI-based medical imaging and the programming skills to turn imaging models and algorithms into efficient software on AMD hardware. You have demonstrated experience writing code, profiling and tuning performance, and solving difficult technical problems. You can distinguish improvements that matter to a clinical imaging workflow running on device from gains in an isolated benchmark and communicate your findings clearly to both domain experts and systems engineers.

 

We value depth in one or more relevant areas, curiosity across the clinical, algorithmic, and systems disciplines, and the ability to take ownership of a technical project from investigation to validated results.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Analyze modern AI-based medical imaging pipelines, understanding their clinical objectives, algorithms, computational requirements, and practical limitations.
  • Collaborate with research and industry partners to design and build new AI models for medical imaging.
  • Build or modify components of medical imaging pipelines across modalities such as ultrasound, CT, MRI, and X-ray.
  • Prepare, preprocess, and validate imaging data in coordination with the team’s data-handling and privacy procedures.
  • Integrate and evaluate AI models for tasks such as reconstruction, segmentation, detection, classification, and tracking.
  • Measure and profile model and pipeline performance against agreed metrics such as latency, throughput, occupancy, and memory use.
  • Develop agentic frameworks that let domain experts target AMD devices more efficiently at the algorithm and graph-design level.
  • Develop prototypes, scripts, tests, and technical documentation.
  • Present findings and recommendations to internal teams, collaborators, and partners.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

  • Strong programming skills in Python and experience with C++ or another language used for high-performance computing.
  • Hands-on experience implementing machine learning or deep learning models for imaging applications.
  • Experience with agentic design flows and AI coding tools such as Claude.
  • Solid understanding of image processing and common medical imaging concepts.
  • Experience profiling, debugging, and improving computational software.
  • Ability to make progress independently while  on a defined technical problem and collaborate effectively across medical and engineering disciplines.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

  • Medical imaging modalities such as ultrasound, CT, MRI, or X-ray, in depth.
  • Imaging libraries and formats such as SimpleITK, ITK, MONAI, OpenCV, DICOM, and NIfTI.
  • Deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, including custom operators or distributed training and inference.
  • Inference deployment and optimization with ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, ROCm, MIGraphX, HIP, CUDA, Triton, or comparable stacks.
  • Real-time, embedded, or GPU-accelerated pipelines.
  • GPU profiling and tuning of AI models to target GPU hardware more effectively.
  • Clinical or regulated data workflows, demonstrated through research, coursework, or projects.

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS

Master’s or PhD in Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Medical Physics, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience preferred.

 

LOCATION: Longmont, CO; Austin, TX and Santa Clara, Ca are options. 

 

This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.
